comparison.objective: Mount a spring-loaded rack rail between two posts at a marked rack position; candidate removes four HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Title indicates spring compression, two-post alignment, and rail mounting; candidate tests narrow coaxial tooling, controlled hammer impact, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: The body and rubric are absent, so engagement tolerances and damage rules are unknown; the stated finish is a mounted rail, unlike four fractured and contained tangs with retained inserts.
comparison.reason: Spring-loaded mounting and notch-fracture finishing have different mechanisms and outcomes; missing thresholds alone do not make them plausible duplicates.
